how: race_gear.py: Dwarf is Alliance, so it can't wear the Horde rewards of the preset's level60_phase0_arms. It wears level60_phase0_arms_alliance, the same set with those slots re-ranked at a Alliance race (bis_phase0.sh RANK_ONLY SLOTS), kept by the rule, without a sim. On it, Dwarf hit 9.1% against the 8% yellow cap, the set's own hit 8.1%: 1% (10 budget points) re-spent over the set's shares at the 1b prices (Strength 42.7%, CritRating 25.4%, AttackPowerBoth 18.2%, Agility 13.7%). Hit and crit are one pool for the gear, so each is written once. Dwarf 996.9 with the set, 1002.7 with the swap; gain.se is the paired error (the same seeded fights), 0.60 unpaired.
